journey.name: Gateway Health, Circuit Reset and Metrics
journey.description: Validates that an administrator can inspect real-time payment gateway health including circuit breaker states, success rates, latency, failure counts, and manually reset an open circuit breaker after confirmation.

story.title: View gateway performance metrics and latency
Gateway alert states on degraded health

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard and navigate to '/dashboard/payment-gateways'.
Verify the gateway cards show circuit states ('CLOSED', 'OPEN', or 'HALF_OPEN') with color-coded badges.
Verify each card displays recent failure count, success rate percentage, average latency in milliseconds, and fallback rate.
Verify an open circuit displays the time it opened and next retry timestamp, alongside a top warning alert banner.
Click 'Reset Circuit' on a gateway card and verify the confirmation modal opens with details about resuming live transaction attempts.
Click 'Confirm Reset' and verify the circuit breaker status refreshes to CLOSED with a success confirmation toast.
